name: Spike Thrower Trap (CR —)
body:
Spike Thrower Trap
CR –

Type mechanical; Perception DC 15; Disable Device DC 18

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (by operator); Reset manual (full-round action)
Effect Atk +3 ranged (2d4 piercing); uses operator’s ranged attack (listed value is for a ghast), separate attack roll for each target in the north half of the room.
